description: Absent scanner binaries degrade gracefully: the scenario stays fully functional on the host-present subset (gitleaks + gosec + pnpm audit) and records missing optional scanners as INFO observations.

requirements.title: Skip-not-fail on absent scanner
requirements.description: When a scanner binary is not found on PATH, its runner must emit a single INFO observation ('scanner <name> not installed; skipped') and the overall validation must still succeed using whatever scanners are present.

validation.notes: With govulncheck absent, validation completes and emits an INFO observation rather than an error.
With only gitleaks+gosec present, a Go scenario still produces a valid (possibly empty) findings set and exit code reflects only real findings.
